# HealthInsight — Analytics Support Matrix (Prompt 04)
**Basis:** Strictly derived from `docs/dataset_dictionary.md` generated by Apache Spark.  
**Rule:** No fabricated columns, no assumed schemas. Unsupported metrics are explicitly declared unsupported.

---

## 1. Supported Analytical Capabilities

| Analytic Metric | Required Source Fields | Present in Dataset? | Supported? | Verified Source Columns & Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Total Patients** | Unique Patient Identifier | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `patients.csv -> Id` (12,352 distinct non-null UUIDs). |
| **Total Encounters** | Unique Encounter Identifier | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> Id` (321,528 distinct non-null UUIDs). Exactly 1 row/encounter. |
| **Condition Frequency** | SNOMED Code / Clinical Description | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `conditions.csv -> CODE, DESCRIPTION` (114,544 records, 0 nulls). |
| **Condition Prevalence by Gender** | Patient Gender + Condition Link | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `patients.csv -> GENDER` ('M' / 'F') joined via `conditions.csv -> PATIENT`. |
| **Condition Prevalence by Age Group** | Birth Date + Diagnosis Start Date | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `patients.csv -> BIRTHDATE` and `conditions.csv -> START`. Age calculated at event time: `floor(months_between(START, BIRTHDATE)/12)`. |
| **Encounter Volume by Class** | Clinical Encounter Class | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> ENCOUNTERCLASS` (`wellness`, `ambulatory`, `inpatient`, `emergency`, `urgentcare`). |
| **Monthly Encounter Trends** | Visit Start Timestamp | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> START` (Timestamp parsed to `YYYY-MM` grain). |
| **Organization Encounter Volume** | Facility ID & Name | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> ORGANIZATION` joined to `organizations.csv -> Id, NAME` (5,499 facilities). |
| **Average Encounter Duration** | Start and Stop Timestamps | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> START, STOP` (Duration calculated in minutes and fractional days). |
| **Average & Total Recorded Costs** | Financial Cost Columns | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> TOTAL_CLAIM_COST, BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST` (Inferred as `double`, 0 nulls). Labeled as synthetic recorded costs. |
| **Payer Coverage Ratio** | Insurance Coverage vs Total Cost | Yes | **SUPPORTED** | `encounters.csv -> PAYER_COVERAGE, TOTAL_CLAIM_COST`. |

---

## 2. Explicitly Unsupported Analytics & Non-Goals

| Analytic Metric | Missing / Incompatible Fields | Status | Architectural Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Disease Prediction / Risk Scoring** | Requires longitudinal outcome labels & ML models | ❌ **UNSUPPORTED** | Explicitly out of scope. HealthInsight is a descriptive analytics platform, not an AI diagnosis system. |
| **Medication Adherence Scoring** | `medications.csv` lacks patient pill ingestion timestamps | ❌ **UNSUPPORTED** | Prescriptions and dispensations exist, but actual patient adherence telemetry is unavailable. |
| **Real-Time Vitals Alerting** | Batch CSV data lacks sub-second streaming feeds | ❌ **UNSUPPORTED** | Real-time streaming (Kafka/Flink) is explicitly excluded from the stack architecture. |
| **Clinical Treatment Recommendations** | Requires expert clinical guidelines & EHR approval | ❌ **UNSUPPORTED** | Platform does not provide prescriptive medical advice. |
| **Billing Fraud Detection** | Synthetic Synthea claims follow standard billing rules | ❌ **UNSUPPORTED** | Synthea does not simulate fraudulent billing patterns. |
